Sahil Iyer
Digital Marketing Manager | Bengaluru
sahil.iyer625@example.com | +91 9838762373 | 60 days notice

Results-driven digital marketing manager with a strong analytical background and a focus on data-led growth. Combines technical understanding from an M.Tech in Data Science with hands-on campaign execution to improve acquisition, conversion, and retention. Comfortable working cross-functionally in Agile environments to deliver measurable business outcomes.

Experience
Covalent Infotech — Mar 2025 - Present
Digital Marketing Manager (Remote/Hybrid)
- Led an SEO program that increased organic sessions by 48% over six months by implementing technical fixes, content clustering, and on-page optimization; tracked improvements using GA4 and reported weekly dashboards via HubSpot integration.
- Managed Google Ads campaigns with a focus on performance marketing, reducing cost-per-acquisition by 32% while scaling monthly lead volume by 2.6x through search and remarketing strategies.
- Built and maintained conversion tracking across channels in GA4 and HubSpot, enabling closed-loop attribution and improving lead-to-opportunity conversion rate by 19%; coordinated sprint work and priorities using Agile and Jira.
- Launched an onboarding nurture using HubSpot workflows that increased MQL-to-SQL velocity by 22% and automated reporting templates for stakeholders to monitor SEO and paid performance.

Projects
- SEO Technical Sprint: Led a 4-week cross-functional sprint to remediate site speed and crawlability issues, resulting in a 35% improvement in mobile page load and measurable uplifts in indexed pages (tracked in GA4).
- Paid Channel Experimentation: Ran A/B tests on search ad creatives and landing pages integrated with HubSpot forms; one test improved landing page conversion rate by 27%, feeding into campaign optimizations.

SEO | Google Ads | GA4 | HubSpot | Agile | Jira
